summary: A new Mentor window: speed choices, Windows sleep and time zone, sound and USB devices, Windows Hello, backups, and it updates itself.
The Mentor window says when a new version is ready, and after it was updated.
A shorter Mentor window: the owl and Start side by side.
One volume: Windows' volume and Mentor's are kept the same, mute too.
A small fix: after Mentor restarts, the launcher no longer keeps an old volume watch running.
One Start overâ€¦ button (it took Reinstall's place) that says everything that is lost and offers a backup first; the screen switches share one row; the owl is larger, above Start.
A Mentor that is slow to start is no longer stopped and started again after 8 minutes; the mouse is only caught in full screen, in a game.
Mentor no longer stays frozen after the computer wakes from sleep.
The Mentor window's title no longer shows a keyboard hint that is not needed.
Pictures from Windows' Print Screen reach Mentor sooner, even right after a snip.
A loading window until Mentor's desktop is ready, and a wider, simpler Mentor window.
The loading window also shows Ctrl+Alt+Backspace: help, if Mentor gets stuck.
Mentor's owl icon stays on the taskbar: QEMU's icon no longer comes back when the window appears.
Repair starts with the loading window, the mouse leaves the repair screen at every edge, and a few Repairs in a row no longer lead to a restore point.
